name: Chirru-site
description: Chirru-site is a personal portfolio web application showcasing projects, education, and contact information. The frontend is built with React (Vite) and Tailwind CSS with smooth animations via Framer Motion. A minimal Express backend powers a secure contact form, sending emails with Nodemailer.
